notes.title: NEW MONSTERS ARE HERE !
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

For our release day we add very rare monsters to pool. You can collect them by a small chance depends on their rarity level. You can see our new friends at the bottom of this post.

Added Monster Names: "Panther" < "Golem" < "Slug Queen" < "Flying Demon" < "Cerberus" < "Fancy Worm"

Happy release day. Wish you a big luck! ❤️
